name: MEC E Open House Stall
shortDescription: Start your visit at the Mechanical Engineering stall in the VVC gym.

name: MEC E Program Presentation
shortDescription: Hear from the department about the Mechanical Engineering program, 10:00 to 11:00 AM in ETLC E1-001.

name: Tour Start – West Entry
shortDescription: Begin the MEC E building tour on the 2nd floor, just east of the elevators.

name: Undergraduate Design Courses
shortDescription: See projects from the undergraduate mechanical design courses.

name: Autonomous Robotic Vehicle Project (ARVP)
shortDescription: Members from any field of study are welcome as ARVP provides the education, experience, and training to become a subject matter expert in one portion of ARVP's vehicle design.
moreDescription: ARVP is governed by a triple mandate to provide skills in mechatronics, provide a social support network for students, and provide opportunities to network with companies in the robotics industry. So in addition to onboarding and work on our robots, ARVP is committed to providing social events, company tours, and job opportunities.

name: EcoCar
shortDescription: The University of Alberta EcoCar is a student vehicle project group which designs and builds ultra-efficient hydrogen fuel cell powered cars to participate in the annual Shell Eco-Marathon competition in the Hydrogen Fuel Cell category. We build circuit boards, design suspensions and fuel cells, develop autonomous technology, and more by ourselves.

name: UAlberta Formula Racing
shortDescription: We're a team of U of A students who design and build a formula style race car every year, then race it against university teams from around the world at Formula SAE. The club has been running since 1998.
moreDescription: The car is electric. We switched from gas in 2024, and that first EV could do 0 to 100 km/h in under 4 seconds.

Students build nearly all of it: frame, suspension, battery pack, motor setup, aero, wiring. Most of the fabrication happens in the Elko Engineering Garage. You'll learn to run a CNC mill and a laser cutter, and you'll spend plenty of time with the 3D printers. A lot of what you learn in first-year physics shows up here as a real part that you designed, made, and then watched get tested hard.

Not everyone is in mechanical. We have electrical students, computer students, and people from other programs too. You don't need to know anything about cars to start. You just need to want to build something.

name: MEC E 403 – Mechanical Engineering Laboratory II
shortDescription: Step inside a senior undergraduate lab and see the experiments students run.

name: Dean's Research Awards and Capstone Projects
shortDescription: Explore undergraduate research and final-year capstone design projects.

name: AlbertaSat
shortDescription: AlbertaSat is a group of students and faculty at the University of Alberta that have come together to design, build, test, and operate satellites. Our goal is to support Albertan and Canadian access to space through high-impact small-satellite missions. We achieve this through ambitious spacecraft mission execution, development of open-source CubeSat components, and our award-winning outreach program. Beyond students working with spacecraft, we’re also a network of passionate individuals working in space science and technology, representing Alberta’s aerospace talent on the global stage.

name: Student Team for Alberta Rocketry Research
shortDescription: The Student Team for Alberta Rocketry Research (STARR) is a team of like-minded students from an array of disciplines and faculties who seek to expand Alberta’s space industry through the development, testing, and launching of high altitude sounding rockets in intercollegiate competitions. Our mission is to provide experience for students in developing launch vehicles and scientific payloads, educate the public through outreach activities, and promote STEM to students across Alberta. We also seek to provide to our members the necessary experience and skills to pursue a career in the aerospace industry and strengthen Alberta's position as a leader in the Canadian aerospace community.

name: Engineers for a Sustainable World
shortDescription: ESW uAlberta is affiliated with Engineers for a Sustainable World, an international nonprofit network of students and professionals working together with a shared passion to solve sustainability challenges. They envision a world of environmental, social and economic prosperity.
moreDescription: ESW uAlberta aims to support this vision by engaging the University of Alberta community in sustainable activities through events and projects. The group was founded in 2022 by diverse critical thinkers eager to collaborate with others in the journey towards sustainable spaces and practices. ESW uAlberta hopes to continuously create innovative designs to make the University of Alberta campus more sustainable and foster a vibrant community along the way.

name: Mechanical Engineering Club
shortDescription: The Mechanical Engineering Club offers a variety of services to mechanical engineering students, ranging from social events, professional events, intramural teams, selling snacks, and printing services.

name: MEC E 301 – Mechanical Engineering Laboratory I
shortDescription: Watch live demonstrations from the first mechanical engineering lab course.

name: Mission SpaceWalker
shortDescription: Mission SpaceWalker is an interdisciplinary team of young women dedicated to advancing space research and increasing diversity in the aerospace and STEM industries. Their projects blend engineering, science, and environmental research with a commitment to equity and innovation. Annually, they participate in competitions organized by SEDS Canada in collaboration with the CSA.

name: UAlberta Aerial Robotics Group (UAARG)
shortDescription: A student group motivated to building the future of autonomous aircraft. Since inception in 2004, their focus lies in overcoming complex engineering challenges associated with fully autonomous drones. They design, manufacture, and rigorously test their drones from scratch while annually representing the University of Alberta in national and international RPAS competitions.

name: Aero Design
shortDescription: Multi-disciplinary student club dedicated to designing, manufacturing, and testing an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Their mission is to inspire students in pursuing their passion for aerospace through hands-on engineering experience by designing, manufacturing, and flying innovative fixed-wing UAVs. Each year they compete in the SAE Aero Design international competition.

name: Mechatronics Club (MCTR Club)
shortDescription: A student-run community for the Mechatronics Engineering students. They represent the student body, and organize social and professional development events.

name: Room 3-1: MEC E Program Presentation
shortDescription: Stop by Room 3-1 during the building tour to learn about the Mechanical Engineering program and ask the department your questions.
